##### Heroic Abilities

You master a range of [heroic abilities](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability), all of which cost drama to empower them.

###### 3-Drama Ability

Choose one [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) from the following options, each of which costs 3 drama to use. (*Quick Build:* [Harsh Critic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/harsh-critic).)

###### 5-Drama Ability

Choose one [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) from the following options, each of which costs 5 drama to use. (*Quick Build:* [Dramatic Reversal](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-reversal).)
